IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Rodne, Overstreet, Shea, Taylor, Haler, and Magendanz

Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the state of Washington and its political subdivisions from adopting and developing environmental and developmental policies that would infringe or restrict private property rights without due process.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the state of Washington and itspolitical subdivisions from adopting and developing environmental anddevelopmental policies that would infringe or restrict private propertyrights without due process; adding a new section to chapter 42.04 RCW;and adding a new section to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) As used in this section, "political subdivision" means thestate, any county, incorporated city, unincorporated city, public localentity, special purpose district, publicprivate partnership, and anyother public entity of the state, a county, or city. (2) The state of Washington and all political subdivisions may notadopt or implement policy recommendations that deliberately orinadvertently infringe or restrict private property rights without dueprocess as may be required by policy recommendations originating in ortraceable to Agenda 21, adopted by the United Nations in 1992 at itsconference on environment and development, or any other international p. 1 HB 1165law or ancillary plan of action that contravenes the Constitution ofthe United States or the Constitution of the state of Washington. (3) Since the United Nations has accredited and enlisted numerousnongovernmental and intergovernmental organizations to assist in theimplementation of its policies relative to Agenda 21 around the world,the state of Washington and all political subdivisions may not enterinto any agreement, expend any sum of money, or receive fundscontracting services or giving financial aid to or from thenongovernmental and intergovernmental organizations defined in Agenda21.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Section 1 of this act applies to all actions required by or takenunder the authority of this chapter.
